---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
description: "Documentation standards (maintainers-first, factual, verifiable)"
---

# Documentation standards
- Write **factual** docs: avoid marketing language and unverified claims.
- Prefer **copy/pasteable** commands and exact paths.
- Be explicit about assumptions and environment prerequisites.
- Keep structure stable where possible:
  - Overview
  - How to run / How to test
  - Configuration
  - Troubleshooting
  - Security considerations (if relevant)
- When you update behavior or ops model, update docs in the same change-set.
